nl_assertions.nl_assertion: The assistant reports that reservation 5HK4LR keeps outbound HAT115 on May 17 and changes the May 28 return to HAT062 because the total additional charge is $36, no more than the user's $100 limit; all other reservation fields remain unchanged.
nl_assertions.justification: The assistant calculated the return flight change from HAT288 at $154 to HAT062 at $172 as an $18 increase per passenger, totaling $36 for two passengers, which is within the $100 limit. After confirmation, the assistant updated the reservation to keep HAT115 unchanged, changed the May 28 return to HAT062, charged $36 to the Mastercard ending 7369, and preserved cabin, passengers, baggage, insurance, and route.
